title: Azure
description: Azure integration for Port Ocean, including Azure Resource Manager resources and auto-discovered Azure AI Foundry projects.

configurations.name: azureClientId
configurations.description: Azure Client ID. For more information on how to create and manage credentials, see the Azure documentation.

configurations.name: azureClientSecret
configurations.description: Azure Client Secret. For more information on how to create and manage credentials, see the Azure documentation.

configurations.name: azureTenantId
configurations.description: Azure Tenant ID. For more information on how to create and manage credentials, see the Azure documentation

configurations.name: createFoundryWebhooks
configurations.title: Create Foundry webhooks
configurations.description: When true, registers Foundry account webhooks on startup so invoke runs can complete via response.* events. Leave false unless you use Foundry invoke actions with reportInvocationStatus.

extraVars.name: event_grid_system_topic_name
extraVars.description: The name of the event grid system topic of type Microsoft.Resources.Subscriptions to use to receive events from Azure. If not set, a new topic will be created. Note that Azure supports only one Microsoft.Resources.Subscriptions topic in account.

extraVars.name: included_event_types
extraVars.description: A list of resources to filter events from Azure.

extraVars.name: action_permissions_list
extraVars.description: A list of permissions that will be assigned to the Azure Integration User to export Azure Resources.

actions.name: create_agent
actions.description: Create a Foundry agent in the configured project. Port toolbox wiring happens on invoke_agent (enablePortMcp), not here.

inputs.name: projectEndpoint
inputs.title: Foundry project endpoint
inputs.description: Foundry project data-plane URL, e.g. https://<account>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project>.

inputs.name: config
inputs.title: Additional configuration
inputs.description: Optional advanced agent configuration deep-merged into the Foundry create payload (for example definition.tools, description, metadata, rai_config, or a non-prompt definition.kind). First-class fields (name, model, instructions) always win. Reference trigger data with double brackets, for example: {{ .trigger.by.user.email }}.

actions.name: update_agent
actions.description: Update a Foundry agent. Port toolbox remint happens on invoke_agent, not here.

inputs.name: projectEndpoint
inputs.title: Foundry project endpoint
inputs.description: Foundry project data-plane URL, e.g. https://<account>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project>.

inputs.name: config
inputs.title: Additional configuration
inputs.description: Optional advanced agent configuration deep-merged into the Foundry update payload (for example definition.tools, description, metadata). First-class fields (model, instructions) always win. Agent names are immutable. Reference trigger data with double brackets, for example: {{ .trigger.by.user.email }}.

inputs.name: projectEndpoint

actions.name: deploy_model_deployment
actions.description: Deploy a model in the configured Foundry project

inputs.name: projectEndpoint
inputs.title: Foundry project endpoint
inputs.description: Foundry project data-plane URL, e.g. https://<account>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project>.

inputs.name: config

actions.name: invoke_agent
actions.description: Invoke a Foundry agent via the Responses API. Optionally creates/remints the Port toolbox before the call (first invoke does full wiring).

inputs.name: projectArmId
inputs.title: Foundry project ARM ID
inputs.description: ARM resource id for the project: /subscriptions/.../resourceGroups/.../providers/Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/.../projects/.... Data-plane URL is derived from this id for invoke and MCP remint.

inputs.name: conversationId
inputs.title: Conversation ID
inputs.description: Optional Foundry conversation ID to continue multi-turn chat history. When omitted, a new conversation is created for the invoke.

inputs.name: conversationMetadata
inputs.title: Conversation metadata
inputs.description: Optional metadata to set on the conversation before invoke (for example subject, ticket id, or owner). Applied on create when conversationId is omitted, or patched onto an existing conversationId.

inputs.name: enablePortMcp
inputs.title: Enable Port MCP
inputs.description: When true and a Service Account execution identity is present, remints Port MCP CustomKeys and ensures Port tools are in a Foundry toolbox before invoke. Prompt agents: Port-owned port-mcps-<hash> is created/reused by default; a foreign toolbox is left alone unless useExistingToolbox is true. Hosted agents: omit toolboxName to prepare port-mcps-<hash>, or pass toolboxName to upsert into an existing toolbox. Same-agent invokes are serialized so remints do not race.

inputs.name: gitProvider
inputs.title: Git provider
inputs.description: Git provider for gitAccessToken. Only github is supported.

inputs.name: gitAccessToken
inputs.title: Git access token
inputs.description: Optional GitHub PAT. When set, remints the per-agent GitHub MCP connection and includes GitHub MCP in the Port toolbox for this invoke. Omit to skip GitHub MCP.

inputs.name: useExistingToolbox
inputs.title: Use existing toolbox
inputs.description: Prompt agents only (ignored for hosted). When false (default), a foreign/custom toolbox on the agent causes Port/GitHub MCP setup to be skipped with a warning so shared toolboxes are not mutated; Port-owned port-mcps-<hash> is still created or reused. When true, Port tools are merged into the agent's existing toolbox (attach skipped). Shared toolboxes affect every agent that uses them.

inputs.name: toolboxName
inputs.title: Toolbox name
inputs.description: Hosted agents only (ignored for prompt). Existing Foundry toolbox to upsert Port/GitHub MCP into; the toolbox must already exist or the action fails. Passing this name is consent to edit that toolbox. Omit to prepare the Port-owned port-mcps-<hash> toolbox (set TOOLBOX_NAME in the hosted agent to the same name).

inputs.name: reportInvocationStatus
inputs.title: Report invocation status
inputs.description: When true, keeps the run open until a terminal Foundry response.* webhook or SSE event completes it. When false, closes the run after the invoke is submitted. The Responses request always uses background=true.

actions.name: invoke_model
actions.description: Invoke a chat-capable model deployment via the project openai/v1/responses API. Requires capabilities.chat_completion=true (Decision/SystemOne and other non-chat deployments are rejected).

inputs.name: projectArmId
inputs.title: Foundry project ARM ID
inputs.description: ARM resource id for the project: /subscriptions/.../resourceGroups/.../providers/Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/.../projects/.... Data-plane URL is derived from this id.

inputs.name: deploymentName
inputs.title: Deployment name
inputs.description: Foundry model deployment name with capabilities.chat_completion=true. Non-chat deployments (e.g. Microsoft-Decision-1) are rejected.

inputs.name: input
inputs.title: Input
inputs.description: Plain-text user prompt for the Responses API input field.

inputs.name: conversationId
inputs.title: Conversation ID
inputs.description: Optional Foundry conversation ID to continue multi-turn chat history. When omitted, a new conversation is created for the invoke.
